_comment: English texts for the room editor (editmode.lua): tabs, the buttons under a selected item, the hint line, the door label. Keys are stable ids; this file is the fallback for every other language.
hint_default: Edit Mode  —  pick a tab, choose an item, click to place.  [Tab] done
hint_moving_wall: Moving %s   ·   point at a wall slot (low/high) · %s · [Esc] cancels
hint_door_tab: Door  —  the ghost tile follows your cursor along the front edge; click to move the doorway
hint_eraser: Eraser  —  click a placed item, rug or paint to remove it (back to stock)
hint_placing: Placing %s   ·   wheel rotates · click a green spot · [Esc] cancels
hint_placing_wall: Placing %s   ·   wheel flips low/high mount · click a green spot · [Esc] cancels
hint_painting: Painting %s   ·   click & drag to apply many · [Esc] cancels
hint_selected: %s  —  use the buttons under it, drag it to move, or click elsewhere to dismiss
hint_door_sliding: Sliding the door along the front
hint_door_hover: Door  —  drag to slide it along the front (or use the Door tab)
hint_hover_item: Click %s to select it (drag moves it)
door_help: Click a highlighted tile along the front edge to move the door there.
eraser_help: Click a placed item to remove it — furniture, wall items, rugs and wall paint go back to stock.
